foir.why: Industry-cited ideal FOIR range is 40-50%; using the upper bound as a single assumed cap.
foir.source: Poonawalla Fincorp, L&T Finance, IndusInd Bank (mid-2026); our judgement within the cited range

retirementAge.why: Approximate lender-cap convention for loan-end age by income type. Only 'salaried' is wired into the engine so far.

rateBands.why: Never default unknown credit score to worst-case or best-case; widest band + low confidence instead.
rateBands.source: Finance Buddha, OnePaisa, FinanceFunda, Paisabazaar (mid-2026, personal loan segment)

processingFee.why: Market-observed range is 0.5-5%; using a mid-range band, not the extremes.

highCostDebt.why: Used to estimate a monthly interest-only servicing cost for high-cost debt where no EMI is stated, so it still affects the affordability math, not just the override flag.
highCostDebt.source: our judgement, informed by observed app-loan/informal-lender rates

bounceOverride.why: A single old/isolated bounce should not auto-reject; only a RECENT bounce combined with high-cost debt should override the math.

stressCase.why: O4 requires one stress case (income drop or rate rise); chose income drop as the more universally relevant risk across income types.

neededEmiRateStrategy.why: Using the optimistic/low end of the assumed rate band to compute the EMI needed for the requested amount, rather than the midpoint or conservative high end.
